# Gastroenterology Associates of Gainesville, P.C.

Gastroenterology Associates of Gainesville, P.C. is a Medical Practices company. Gastroenterology Associates of Gainesville is an independent specialty practice dedicated to providing the highest quality of gastroenterology services. They are board-certified in gastroenterology and offer special expertise in treating digestive issues and diseases. They strive to stress patient privacy, confidentiality, and satisfaction. Gastroenterology Associates of Gainesville, P.C. employs 13 people (+9.7% YoY, +3 people) and has an annual revenue of $20.2M, founded in 1981. Headquartered in Gainesville, Georgia, United States, with offices in Dawsonville, Braselton, Demorest, and Buford.

## About

Established in 1981, Gastroenterology Associates of Gainesville is the largest gastroenterology practice in Northeast Georgia. With a large dedicated staff of physicians and mid-level providers, we are able to offer the highest quality of gastroenterology services in an efficient and cost conscious manner, while maintaining a commitment to compassion. 

Our physicians are expertly trained in endoscopic procedures, which allow direct visualization of the intestinal tract for optimal diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of gastrointestinal illnesses. We understand the sensitive nature of gastrointestinal illnesses and strive to provide our services in an environment which stresses patient privacy and confidentiality. 

In addition to our highly qualified physicians, our support staff works to make your experience a pleasant one. As a Gastroenterology Associates of Gainesville patient, you will appreciate the service you'll receive from our:

-Medical Team: Our medical team assists the doctors, provides phone support to answer patient questions and concerns, provides laboratory services, and schedules procedures and tests.

-Insurance and Billing Team: Our insurance and billing team work diligently to keep accounts in order.

-Medical Records: Our professional medical records department manages all records along with providing in-house medical transcription services.

-Pre-certification Department: Our pre-certification department works with insurance to pre-certify all procedures and tests, and is available to assist patients with any problems.

-Receptionists and Front Office Staff: Our professional receptionists and office staff will assist you in a kind and professional manner to ensure your office visits and phone calls produce the results you want.

For more information on Gastroenterology Associates of Gainesville, or to schedule an appointment, contact us today.

- Type: Partnership
- Headquarters: Gainesville, United States
- Founded Year: 1981
- Homepage: gastrogainesville.com
- Status: active
- Ownership: Private
- Aliases: gastroenterology associates of gainesville, p.c., gastroenterology associates of gainesville, gastroenterology associate

“We’ve discovered that the prep time for the patient in the pre-op area is at least six minutes faster now. That six-minute saving is hugely satisfying for the patient and for us. Throughput is now faster, so we can do more endo procedures in a day.“

JENNIFER BROWN, RN, BSM, ENDOSCOPY NURSE MANAGER

## BACKGROUND

Over the years, Gastroenterology Associates of Central Virginia has grown from a two-physician, three-staff office, to an eight-physician, six-nurse-practitioner office with over 90 support staff, an AAAHC-accredited endoscopy center and a research division.

The practice was using separate software systems in the office, endoscopy center and hospital. Interface interruptions were frequent and required manual data transfer that was time-consuming. The physicians decided to make a change to the gGastro® suite from ModMed®, which includes gGastro Endoscopy Report Writer (ERW), gGastro EHR software, gPM practice management system, and ModMed Pay for payment processing.

Endoscopy Nurse Manager Jennifer Brown shares how switching to the all-in-one gastroenterology software has lowered costs, helped the practice conduct more endo procedures and saved time on each patient.

## ALL-IN-ONE COST SAVINGS

gGastro has eliminated duplicate charting. Having an all-in-one GI-specific platform, compared to disjointed systems, ensures the patient information is always up to date and accessible in the office chart, in the endo chart, and in the hospital chart. For example, if we’re logged into the chart from the endo center, we can view the office visit notes on the same screen, including prescriptions. I can see what’s going on with that patient from start to finish — from the time they contacted our office until their procedure is complete.

Our previous solutions required a full-time third-party IT person to manage the various platforms and deal with the multiple interface issues we experienced. That extra resource and cost is no longer needed with gGastro. Additionally, the cost and man-hours of data input from one system to another are saved. In the endo center, we had two staff members who left for personal reasons, and I didn’t have to replace those people. We are able to work with two fewer FTEs because we don’t need to spend extra time manually entering information. The cost savings have been across the board.

# gGastro EHR 5.0 from Modernizing Medicine® Launches with a New User Experience that Further Speeds up Documentation

Share

---

Latest version is faster than ever and comes pre-loaded with GI content that helps expedite documentation with suggested coding and custom protocols.

gGastro® 5.0 - The Future of GI Software is Here

BOCA RATON, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, Modernizing Medicine® announced its fastest Gastroenterology EHR yet with gGastro® 5.0. Speeding up documentation, on average, by up to 20%, gGastro 5.0 helps doctors document patient health records more efficiently and improves staff communications and the patient experience.

The latest platform’s user experience was designed to be highly intuitive, browser-agnostic, and faster than ever. gGastro 5.0 delivers greater efficiencies with documentation by suggesting coding and using custom templates and Quick Notes in the Endoscopy Report Writer that can save gastroenterologists time. Multiple clinicians can document simultaneously and HD photos and video can be uploaded from the majority of modern imaging equipment. Many of our current customers are impressed with gGastro 5.0’s modern, fresh look and enhanced GI-specific workflows.

"As a beta user, gGastro 5.0 shows some key features of improvement over the preceding version,” said Jagdish Patel, MD, Digestive Health Clinic. “The changes incorporated in this version make it easier to navigate and help save time in the process. The UX is more pleasing to the eye, with added colors and improvements in the icons across the EMR. Being able to reliably dictate directly into the chart saves a few precious moments from having to open up the dictation box, and then transferring it into the chart."

Samuel Gun, DO, FACOI from Tri-County Gastroenterology, commented: “The beauty of having all-in-one gastroenterology software is that it simplifies our processes and reduces redundancies. Having the whole chart accessible in one easy-to-use system is very beneficial for patient care. In addition to increased transparency, I spend less time documenting and more time with patients.”

“Whether moving from room to room in the practice or at the ASC, doing rounds at the hospital, or completing tasks from home, gastroenterologists need the most efficient, mobile, and intuitive EHR that can go the distance,” said Dr. Julie Servoss, Medical Director of Gastroenterology at Modernizing Medicine. “Our mission is to transform the healthcare experience, and with 5.0 we’re taking a significant leap toward improving the user experience for doctors that helps them save time and achieve better outcomes.”

The latest technologies are being deployed in waves reaching all existing Modernizing Medicine gGastro customers throughout the year.

gMed, a Modernizing Medicine company, Showcases Best-of-Breed Technology for Gastroenterologists at ACG 2016 | ModMed

# gMed, a Modernizing Medicine company, Showcases Best-of-Breed Technology for Gastroenterologists at ACG 2016

Oct 11, 2016

All in One Solution Includes New Patient Kiosk, Award-winning Electronic Health Record (EHR) System, Practice Management, Revenue Cycle Management and More

Boca Raton, Fla. – October 11, 2016 – gMed, a Modernizing Medicine company, will showcase gGastro, the complete EHR solution designed specifically for gastroenterologists, at the 2016 American College of Gastroenterology Annual Scientific Meeting (ACG) in Las Vegas.

Committed to providing gastroenterology-specific solutions and services that help physicians improve efficiencies, gMed will present both new solutions and award winning, market leading technology for medical practices, ambulatory surgery centers (ASC) and hospitals. Innovations being showcased at ACG include:

- gKiosk™ – this new platform was built to speed up the check-in process by letting patients update their personal information and medical history and sign consent forms on an iPad. gKiosk integrates with gGastro and gPM™ to add data to the patient’s record automatically.
- gGastro – the gastroenterology-specific EHR system was named Top Ambulatory EHR for gastroenterology by Black Book Rankings’ in 2016 and for six consecutive years.
- gPM™ – an innovative practice management system designed to enhance both the efficiency of workflow and effectiveness of processes. gPM integrates the gastroenterology practice with the endoscopy center to centralize medical and financial data into one system.
- gCharge™ – a fully integrated way to capture hospital charges using mobile technology.
- gInsights™ – an advanced analytical tool that simplifies the process of performance measurement to provide more accurate, timely and efficient reporting.
- Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) – services that can help increase efficiencies and improve financial performance with the combined use of technology, people and processes.

“We look forward to demonstrating how our comprehensive solution suite can help gastroenterologists with every phase of care delivery, from patient check-in, clinical visit, to payment,” said Daniel Cane, CEO and co-founder of Modernizing Medicine. “Since welcoming gMed into the Modernizing Medicine family, we have effectively collaborated around emerging technologies and best practices to innovate highly impactful solutions for gastroenterologists in private practice, ASCs and hospitals.”

Mary Igo, Chief Executive Officer of Digestive Health Specialists in Tacoma, Wash., shares, “Since we began using gGastro in conjunction with gPM in 2014, our multiple clinics and endoscopy centers are now seamlessly integrated. The elimination of redundant data entry has streamlined workflow and saved time, which has been a critical benefit not only for the practice but also for our patients.”

The practice relied on paper-based workflows for many daily tasks and struggled with high call volume and voicemail backlog. Recognizing the need for enhanced efficiency and time-saving features, the group transitioned to gGastro ® ’s GI suite and Klara which led to outstanding results. Sabbaak Waraich, IT Lead, shares the benefits the change has made to the practice and its patients.
